issues.title: Cancel from saved tab calls .includes() on an object
issues.detail: The cancel handler parses events.rsvp (a JSON object keyed by user uuid) into a variable named rsvpArray and calls .includes(userId). Objects have no .includes() method, so this throws a TypeError when the event has any RSVP data.

issues.title: Same bug in the RSVPEvents component
issues.detail: The standalone RSVP events list uses the identical broken cancel pattern: parses the rsvp JSON object and calls .includes() on it, which throws a TypeError.
